question: Related Questions Q. In our Masjid we have 2 Jumu'ah Salaat due to lack of space. The time is very limited so by the time the 2nd Jumu'ah Salaat ends, within 10 minutes Asr time starts. As such most of the musallees who come for 2nd Jumu'ah also want to perform Asr. But the official Asr Jama'at conducted by the main Imam takes place 1 hour after. The other Imam who leads the second Jumu'ah is insisted upon to lead this unofficial Asr Jama'at. Let me tell you a little bit about the Masjid: -We have an appointed Imam -We do not have an appointed Mu'azzin -We have a group of local people who come for every Salaat What procedure should be taken to conduct this unofficial Asr Jama'at without making it Makrooh Tahrimi or Makrooh Tanzihi in Hanafi Mathab? 3269 views Q. Jumuah Khutba and Speech 7786 views Q. Dear Mufti Sahib Assalam o Alikum! I am a researcher in a university in Pohang (a small city in south Korea). Here we have no local muslim community and masjid. Only few muslim students and scholars are present (from other countries) in the university (about 6 to 8). Some time even more or less because visiting scholars come here for a short time. Out of these muslims only 4 come for jumma prayer including me. My other three muslim friends (those who come for jumma prayer) offer jumma Khutba in English some even they say no word in Arabic except Bismillah. Please tell me if our Jumma prayer is valid under these circumstances or not. Some time there are only three persons for jumma prayer. My friends are of the view that jumma can be offered with three persons also. Please also tell me the minimum nember of persons required for validity of jumma prayer. This university is inside the city Pohang. Is Jumma compulsary here? One thing more I want to know is about the person who can lead jumma prayer. My friends have decided that jumma prayer will be lead by every one turn by turn. All other three friends of mine have no beard. They are very strict in their decision and do not want to even listen any body about it. I have told them that jumma prayer is valid only with Arabic Khutba and atleast with four persons but they are not ready to except it. Please tell me what should I do under these circumstances. Should I offer jumma with them or offer my Zuhar prayer alone. Jazakallah. Looking for an early reply in this regard. Wassalam Aman-ur-Rehman 2243 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 827 Country: India Title: Is it a sunnah to hold an aasa by imaam at the time of delivering of juma khutba? Question: Is it a sunnah to hold an aasa by imaam at the time of delivering of juma khutba? Answer ID: 827 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 368=360/M) The scholars of Fiqh have different opinions regarding this matter. The best point of view in this regard is that holding stick (assa) during Jumua prayer is permissible, not makrooh (undesirable). But, considering it as necessary and denouncing those who do not hold it is makrooh (undesirable): ویکرہ ان یتکاٴ علی قوس او عصا اھ قال الشامي: و نقل القھستاني عن عبد المحیط ان اخذ العصا سنة (شامي) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
